description:
CLegendary Launcher is a modern, fast, and modular cross-platform Minecraft launcher built with Avalonia UI for Windows, Linux, and macOS.

Key features:
• Full support for Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, and Quilt loaders.
• Built-in mod and modpack manager with CurseForge and local archive support.
• Play with Friends (P2P) via e4mc tunnels for both vanilla and modpacks without port forwarding.
• Historical BetaCraft versions (Pre-Classic, Classic, Indev, Infdev, Alpha, Beta) with isolated directories and automatic Java detection.
• Multi-account system: Microsoft OAuth, LittleSkin, and offline profiles.
• Automated world backups, AI-powered crash log diagnosis, live server directory, and Discord Rich Presence.
